author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
You cannot be productive if you stay at the cutting edge of AI.  You are trying your luck with the latest model and see whether it can implement your crazy ideas.  

Once the crazy idea becomes just mundane routine tasks that AI can handle reliability, you move on and come up with even crazier ideas that break the AI again.

For example, asking AI to fill in my weekly timesheet was a crazy idea 2 years ago.  Now I just take it for granted.
